parameters: It'll be alright, kiddo. These people are expecting you.
Oh...\| alright, then. Thank you for keeping me safe, Captain Antares...
Welcome to Armitage, child of Donar. I am an official of the Donari Temple. We heard of fierce battles outside the capital. Thank Donar you've arrived safely.
...What do you need me to do, sir?

Oh... nothing, nothing. That is to say, simply make yourself comfortable here in Armitage. Some acolytes of the Sisterhood of Mercy will tend to your needs.\! When the time comes, just follow along as they guide you through the process.\! By the end of today, it is very likely that you will be sanctioned to be Veridia's Empress.
...What in all the world does an Empress do?!
